headline: Approved minutes and entered executive session to discuss Mansfield Heliflight v. Longo et al litigation
summary: The Airport Commission approved the August 5, 2026 meeting minutes and entered executive session to discuss pending litigation, Mansfield Heliflight v. Longo et al, and attorney-client communications. Staff gave updates on finances, construction projects, the Residential Sound Insulation Program, and the Director's Report, including upcoming FAA meetings, grant funding, and building improvements.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the August 5, 2026 meeting, 6-0.

Made a specific finding that premature public knowledge of the Mansfield Heliflight v. Longo et al matter would place the City and Airport at a substantial disadvantage, and voted to enter executive session to discuss the litigation and attorney-client communications.

plain_text:
PATRICK LEAHY BURLINGTON INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT  
BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS 
 MINUTES OF MEETING  
September 2, 2026 
Location: Large Conference Room (Room 337) 
 Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport, Third Floor 
1200 Airport Drive, 
South Burlington, VT 05403 
[Hybrid meeting]          
MEMBERS PRESENT:  Tim George, Chair  
Jeff Schulman, Vice Chair  
Chip Mason  
    Helen Riehle  
Al Turkos 
Andrew Savage   
MEMBERS ABSENT:  Robin Guillian 
BTV STAFF PRESENT:  Nicolas Longo, Director of Aviation  
Madison Reagan, Environmental Compliance and Project Manager 
Larry Lackey, Director of Planning, Engineering and Sustainability 
Dave Carman, Deputy Director – Airport Operations 
Marie Friedman, Director of Finance 
Jeffrey Bartley, Director of Innovation and Marketing 
Romeo von Hermann, Customer Experience Manager 
Jillian Waite, Office Assistant  
 
OTHERS PRESENT:   CCTV 
 
1.0 Call to Order  
1.1 Call to Order 
Aviation Director Nic Longo called the meeting to order at 4:04 P.M. 
1.2 Acknowledgement of Remote Commissioners 
Commissioners attending the meeting remotely identified themselves (Chip Mason and Jeff 
Schulman)
2.0 Agenda 
2.1 Approve/Adopt Agenda  
MOTION by Andrew Savage, SECOND by Helen Riehle, to approve the agenda as presented.  
VOTING: unanimous (6-0), motion carried.  
 
 
3.0 Public Forum 
3.1 Public Forum 
3.1.1 No members of the public present.  
 
4.0 Consent agenda: 
4.1 Approval of the minutes 
MOTION by Helen Riehle, SECOND by Al Turkos, to approve the minutes as presented in 
the agenda packet, including Minutes from the August 5, 2026 meeting.   
VOTING: unanimous (6-0); motion carried. 
 
 
5.0 Executive Session: 
5.1 Approval to move to executive session 
MOTION by Al Turkos, SECOND by Helen Riehle, to move to make a specific finding that 
premature general public knowledge of the matter of Mansfield Heliflight v. Longo et al 
would clearly place the City and Airport at a substantial disadvantage.  
MOTION by Helen Riehle, SECOND by Al Turkos, to move to enter executive session 
pursuant to 1 VSA 313(a)(1)(E)&(F) to discuss pending civil litigation to which the City and 
Airport are parties and to receive confidential attorney-client communications. 
All commissioners, Nic Longo, Larry Lackey, Dave Carman, Marie Friedman, Jeffrey Bartley, and Jillian 
Waite exited the conference room at 4:10pm. 
        MOTION by Andrew Savage, SECOND by Al Turkos, to end executive session at 4:35pm.  
 
6.0 Financial Update  
6.1 Financial Update 
6.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Finance Marie Friedman highlighted the following updates: 
1. We are now in the new 2027 fiscal year. 
2. Our YTD revenue for the first month was 2.6 million dollars.  
3.  Operating revenue is a little higher than last year with our expenses for 
the month being 1.3 million dollars  
4.  Our cash on hand is 2.2, almost 2.3 million dollars. 
5.  Clarified to commissioners that most litigation costs are covered by 
insurance. The rest are lumped in with consultant spending. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
7.0 Construction Update 
7.1 Construction Update, L. Lackey
7.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Engineering and Sustainability Larry Lackey highlighted the following updates: 
1.  SRE building construction will begin September 8th. 
2.  Scheduled meeting with the FAA on September 22nd to review the CIP 
3.  Met with BETA to discuss their Master Plan process with South 
Burlington. Preparing to meet with South Burlington again to include 
this on our Master Plan. 
4. Taxiway line-striping is complete  
5. Received the grant early for the cargo apron expansion, so we’re starting 
construction this year 
 
8.0 Residential Sound Insulation Updates 
8.1 Residential Sound Insulation Program Updates, L. Lackey 
8.1.1 In addition to the written update provided to the Airport Commission, Director of 
Engineering and Sustainability Larry Lackey highlighted the following updates 
1.   Waiting on an FAA close-out to receive final payments  
2.  Phase 3, 4, and 5 are moving to closure 
3.  Applying for another grant to do 50 additional homes in the Spring 
 
 
9.0 Director’s Report 
9.1 Director’s Report, N. Longo 
9.1.1 In addition to the written presentation, Director of Aviation Nic Longo reported: 
1. Majority of internal construction taking place on the second floor 
working around the original terminal building. 
2.  Old observation tower will be back online shortly. 
3.  Going to showcase the original 1948 parts of the building by adding a 
new history museum. 
4.  Beginning work on the SRE project next week. 
5. Partnered with UMass, University of New Hampshire, and the Fairbanks 
Museum on a display that highlights the significance of using mass 
timber in construction. 
6. Received grant for brand new children’s room and Mamava pods. 
7. Upcoming administrative organizational changes, travel plans, and 
events like the FSE, Farmers Markets, and 5K. 
 
 
10.0 Commissioner Items 
10.1 Commissioner Items: 
10.1.1  No commissioner items   
 
11.0 Follow Up Items 
11.1 Artificial Intelligence 
11.1.1   City has almost completed the policy which we will share when we receive it.
11.2 Jet Fuel Taxes 
11.2.1     Discussing with City of South Burlington leaders in October. 
 
12.0 Adjournment 
MOTION by Al Turkos, SECOND by Helen Riehle, to adjourn the meeting.  
VOTING: unanimous (6-0) ; motion carried.  Meeting Adjourned at 5:14 P.M.
